resources.string: Each tap on the Event button (dashboard, Android Auto, notification) keeps the instant and the values read a minute before and 30 s after it. They are also in the CSV recording (marker \"event\") and in the Telegraf export (ecu bimmerdata, id event).
No event yet. While connected, tap the flag next to the connection, in Android Auto or in the notification when something happens.
What did you feel or hear?
No value was read around this event.
Keeping the values of the next 30 s…
The event and the values kept around it are deleted from the phone. Points already exported to Telegraf stay there.
The dashed line is the event. Tap the graph for the values at a time; tap a value to show or hide it.
